claim: You can upgrade an existing Redis OSS cluster to ElastiCache for Valkey in place without downtime, from any version of Redis OSS supported on ElastiCache to any version of ElastiCache for Valkey. An upgrade from Redis OSS versions earlier than 5.0.6 requires DNS propagation that may experience a failover time of 30 to 60 seconds.

evidence.quote: You can upgrade your existing Redis OSS cluster to ElastiCache for Valkey in-place without downtime, and in just a few clicks. You can upgrade from any version of Redis OSS supported on ElastiCache to any version of ElastiCache for Valkey. If you upgrade from Redis OSS versions earlier than 5.0.6, it requires DNS propagation that may experience a failover time of 30 to 60 seconds.
